title: orontium majus
intro: Orontium majus, commonly known as the golden club, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is native to North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The golden club is said to have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and the reduction of pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids and alkaloids, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
